column1: # DeepEngineers canonical SE character skeleton "canon1" (CONTRACT §5.4 "Character", S5; data, no game asset).
# Names and parent links only (no matrix, no geometry), derived 2026-10-17 from the installed SE 1.210.014 models
# Content\Models\Characters\Astronaut\SE_astronaut.mwm and ...\Female\SE_astronaut.mwm, read in place: the 78 bones
# both models share with the same parent name, in the male model's order (the female model lists bones 14-23 in
# another order and has other mesh-node bones, so SE indices are never used across models: the SE plugin maps its
# model's bones to these rows by name). Parents precede children. 81 bones per model, 78 shared; blend indices of
# both LOD0 models stay <= 76, so no vertex weights a non-shared bone.
# Pins: skeleton text = one line "bone <index> <seBone> <parent>\n" per row (columns 1-3 only, parent -1 for the
# root), FNV-1a 64 = 0x995765282e7d4f1d; it is the "skeleton canon1 78 ..." line of the S5 mirror conventions
# (CONTRACT §5.4, conventions hash 0x31dfd6f9befdef5d). Columns 5-7 are Subnautica retarget hints, NOT in the hash:
# they may be refined after the S5 real run without a re-pin.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   index    canonical bone index (C1 bone order, SkinnedBind order, vertex boneIndex values)
#   seBone   SE bone name (MyModelBone.Name)
#   parent   canonical index of the parent, -1 = root
#   seParent SE name of the parent, - = root
#   human    Unity HumanBodyBones enum name for the humanoid retarget (HumanTrait.BoneName[(int)value] at run time), - = none
#   role     root: no retarget, the body transform drives it | human: retargeted | twist: forearm twist, keeps its rest
#            local transform in a retarget | follow: unmapped deforming bone, keeps its rest local transform in a
#            retarget | dummy: attachment point (camera, lights, weapon pins, jetpack), rest local transform in a retarget
#   snBone   Subnautica player-rig bone for the generic retarget path (- = no counterpart: root, dummies, eyes, lids,
#            forearm twists). Filled 2026-10-17 from the S5-2a real run's "s5.rig" row (player_view, generic rig,
#            113 transforms: hips, spine_1..3, chest, neck, head_rig, clav/shoulder/elbow/hand_L|R, thigh/calf/ankle,
#            toe_L_rig / toe_R, fingers hand_<L|R>_<thumb|point|midl|ring|pinky>_<base|mid|tip[_rig]>). Outside the
#            skeleton hash (columns 1-3), so no re-pin; SE Spine1 stays unmapped (SN has four spine bones, SE six).
